title: Installation
description: Documentation for the nnsight Python library

segments.html:
Requirements

  • Python 3.10 or higher
  • PyTorch (installed automatically)
  • transformers 5.x, if you are working with Hugging Face models

Model implementations and architectures change from one transformers version to the next, and pip install nnsight does not pin the major. These docs are written against 5.x, so check what you have:

Install from PyPI

The simplest way to install NNsight is via pip:

Install from Source

For the latest development version, install directly from GitHub:
Or clone the repository and install in editable mode:

segments.code:
git clone https://github.com/ndif-team/nnsight.git
cd nnsight
pip install -e .
